newsitem.title: JAPAN: Calsonic says no comment on big investment report.
newsitem.headline: Calsonic says no comment on big investment report.

text.p: Calsonic Corp said on Tuesday it cannot comment on a media report that the firm will invest a total of 40 billion yen over three years to improve production capacity at its overseas units.

The Nikkei Sangyo Shimbun reported on Tuesday that the car parts maker will spend the money in the three years to March 2001 to boost production capacity at its overseas units, mainly in North America.
But Calsonic, owned 33.3 percent by Nissan Motor Co Ltd, declined to comment. "We cannot make any comment about this report," a Calsonic spokesman said.
Of the total 40 billion yen, 25 billion yen will go towards its North American units including those in Mexico, the daily said.
The decision was based mainly on expectations of a rise in orders from America's "Big Three" automakers, it added.
